LanguageData.LP_Path_Druid.label: druid
LanguageData.LP_Path_Druid.description: The DND druid protects nature: Calm Beast, Conjure Animals, Wild Shape, Beast Lord's Call (Animals), Entangle, Barkskin, Plant Growth, Call Lightning (Plants), and ultimately Control Weather. Either Plants or Animals 6 unlocks the path; each ability uses its own skill (6/9/12/15/18), so training only one still completes half the tree. Effects are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (minimum 0.2, no cap). Liches cannot learn it.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Druid.lockedReason: Requires Plants or Animals 6, or adventurer Wisdom 13 (liches cannot learn it)
LanguageData.LP_Path_Druid.tooltip: Druid: the Plants branch governs plants and weather, the Animals branch governs beasts and shapeshifting.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Sorcerer.label: sorcerer
LanguageData.LP_Path_Sorcerer.description: The DND sorcerer is born with magic: Chaos Bolt, Charm Person, Dragon Wings, Mass Suggestion (Social), Burning Hands, Twinned Spell, Ice Storm, Empowered Spell (Intellectual), and ultimately Wild Surge. Either Social or Intellectual 6 unlocks the path; genasi, genies, titans, storm giants, cloud giants and mariliths have a sorcerer bloodline: all requirements -2, innate power +15%. Effects are multiplied by psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Sorcerer.lockedReason: Requires Social or Intellectual 6 (4 with a sorcerer bloodline), or adventurer Charisma 13
LanguageData.LP_Path_Sorcerer.tooltip: Sorcerer: the Social branch is innate charm magic, the Intellectual branch is metamagic and elements.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Artificer.label: artificer
LanguageData.LP_Path_Artificer.description: The DND artificer forges magic into devices: Arcane Workshop, Quick Repair, Rune Inscription, Overcharged Shot, Arcane Charge, Master Craftsmanship, Mountain Forge, Rune Turret and Arcane Resonance. Device power grows with Crafting level; each tier requires the matching Crafting level (6/9/12/15/18). With VPE installed, all craftable DND weapons (rune firearms, staves, ogre clubs and nonlethal weapons) require the matching artificer passives (Arcane Workshop, Rune Inscription, Mountain Forge) to craft; legendary weapons and throwables are unaffected, and the mod setting "DND weapons need artificer" turns this restriction off.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Artificer.tooltip: Artificer: Crafting sets device power and learnable abilities.
